input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives Customer an unqualified termination-for-convenience right over the Agreement or any Order Form, and Section 29.4 fixes that notice period at thirty days before the effective termination date — matching the preferred 30 days' notice. Customer owes only accrued Fees (no early-termination fee or penalty; the liquidated damages in 7.7 attach to late payment, not termination), and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, reinforced by Section 10.2. Vendor has no reciprocal convenience exit: its termination rights are limited to material breach (9.1), insolvency (9.2), and the narrow IP-remedy carve-out in 20.5/20 (which expressly bars terminating unaffected Services), and 24.4 blocks a change-of-control exit. This satisfies the preferred position for the three-year term in Section 8.1.
